attachedContext.offsetUnit: UTF-16 code units in the bounded assistant text-node projection (meta header, code-block chrome and buttons excluded)
attachedContext.prompt: Appended after the user's text as 'Annotations on earlier assistant output (quoted context; cite as "Annotation N")' with JSON-quoted selections and plain-text comments or '(none)'
attachedContext.durableUserItem: Annotation turns store the user's own text plus the bounded contexts; turns without annotations keep durable text equal to the dispatched prompt
attachedContext.retention: Queue admission charges effective text, original text and attached contexts

selection.loading: One lazy chunk; a core trigger performs a cheap selection check on pointer-up, Shift+Arrow or the menu key and detaches once armed
selection.overlays: Visible pane badges survive focus changes; selection tools belong only to the focused pane

sideChat.identity: Reserved side- UUID; Rust-owned ephemeral and parentChatId tab metadata
sideChat.capability: new session on first send, like any new Chat; never a native fork
sideChat.teardown: Supervisor zero-process proof and exact-owner retained recovery precede deletion; no protocol close capability required
sideChat.cleanup: Scoped deletion and accounting in one exclusive transaction; immutable delete guards restored before commit; rollback restores guards on failure
sideChat.images: Only deleted Chat artifact IDs are removed; post-commit file removal is best effort; startup reclaims orphan files
sideChat.restore: Purged after runtime shutdown on app exit and before startup bootstrap
sideChat.navigation: Excluded from rail, archive, project search and persistence actions

preference.optOut: Persist false only on confirmed close with the checkbox checked

verification.bundle: Desktop-native build: one lazy chunk of about 7.7 KB gzip plus about 1.4 KB gzip in core chunks; core total and Agent-one-chat exceed the unchanged budgets, so delivery needs a budget decision or offsetting reductions
